evidence_quotes.agenda: No quid pro quo framing or agenda question — customer explicitly wanted an early ballpark before she even has a move date or new address.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concern was raised — only pricing/scheduling logistics questions (weekday vs. weekend rates, packing service cost) — scored N/A/full-credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'we are time based, so you only pay for the actual time it takes to move' + confirmed directly when asked, 'if it takes less time it'll be less for me?' — 'yup, that's correct' — a clean, explicit beats-it-pay-less confirmation; no rate-lock/100k line, no self-prep tip, no fairness check.

top_strength: Gave a clear, honest ballpark without over-committing to specifics the customer couldn't yet provide (no set date, no new address), and offered to text the pricing for easy reference.
coaching_note: The estimate was delivered as a bare range without the full anchor-and-personalize framing (no specific factors named beyond square footage), and the damage-coverage/Meet-Your-Mover/On-Time differentiators were skipped entirely on this early-stage shopping call.
